title: Authentication configuration mismatch on auth-service
description: After the auth-service rollout, JWT-signing key lookups fail because the new deployment references a renamed secret volume mount. All token verification requests fail and logins are blocked.
raw_logs: ERROR [auth-service] failed to read signing key: no such file /etc/auth/keys/jwt.pem

raw_events.description: Deployed auth-service v5.2.0 with updated ConfigMap referencing a renamed secret volume mount
